# text.library: ParseInteger

**Status:** Supported (tier `foundation`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> Reads an integer: an optional sign and one or more decimal digits. Anything else,
> and a value outside Integer's range under the profile, has Ok false and Value 0;
> overflow is reported, never wrapped.
> Witness: ParseInteger("-12") is (-12, true); ParseInteger("1.0") is (0, false).

## Signature

```plato
ParseInteger(s: String): IntegerParse
```

### Law_ParseIntegerAcceptedForms

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 109](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L109)

```plato
// Two-line witness: accepted forms and their values.
Law_ParseIntegerAcceptedForms(): Boolean
    => ParseInteger("-12").Ok && ParseInteger("-12").Value == -12 && ParseInteger("+7").Value == 7 && ParseInteger("007").Value == 7
    && ParseInteger("-0").Value == 0 && ParseInteger("-0").Ok && ParseInteger("2147483647").Value == 2147483647 && ParseInteger("-2147483648").Value == -2147483647 - 1;
```

### Law_ParseIntegerRejectedForms

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 114](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L114)

```plato
// Two-line witness: rejected forms and overflow are Ok false with Value 0.
Law_ParseIntegerRejectedForms(): Boolean
    => !ParseInteger("").Ok && !ParseInteger("+").Ok && !ParseInteger("-").Ok && !ParseInteger("1.0").Ok && !ParseInteger("1e3").Ok
    && !ParseInteger(" 1").Ok && !ParseInteger("1 ").Ok && !ParseInteger("--1").Ok && !ParseInteger("0x10").Ok
    && !ParseInteger("99999999999999999999").Ok && !ParseInteger("-99999999999999999999").Ok
    && ParseInteger("99999999999999999999").Value == 0 && ParseInteger("1.0").Value == 0;
```

### Law_ParseIntegerRejectsLetters

[stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato, line 121](../../../../../stdlib/tests/text.laws.plato#L121)

```plato
// A text of letters, the runner's String, is never an integer.
Law_ParseIntegerRejectsLetters(s: String): Boolean
    => s.Count == 0 || !ParseInteger(s).Ok;
```
